components.description: Storybook-only Foundations page for the typography scale. Enumerates the .mud-{desktop|mobile}-* type classes loaded in the preview (.storybook/design-tokens.scss), renders a specimen in each, reads its declared size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing, and copies the class name on click. The Desktop/Mobile toggle switches which scale is shown.

variables.name: CONFIG
variables.defaultValue:
{
  gap: {
    note: 'Flexbox / grid gap utilities on the shared spacing scale (each step = 4px). Click a card to copy the class name.',
    test: /^\.(gap|row-gap|col-gap)-(\d+)$/,
    variantOf: (m) => m[1],
    scaleOf: (m) => Number(m[2]),
    sections: [
      { key: 'gap', title: 'Gap — both axes' },
      { key: 'col-gap', title: 'Column gap — horizontal' },
      { key: 'row-gap', title: 'Row gap — vertical' },
    ],
  },
  margin: {
    note: 'Margin utilities on the shared spacing scale (each step = 4px). The light zone is the margin around the box. Click a card to copy the class name.',
    test: /^\.m([trblxy]?)-(\d+)$/,
    variantOf: (m) => m[1] || 'a',
    scaleOf: (m) => Number(m[2]),
    sections: [
      { key: 'a', title: 'All sides' },
      { key: 'x', title: 'Horizontal — x' },
      { key: 'y', title: 'Vertical — y' },
      { key: 't', title: 'Top' },
      { key: 'r', title: 'Right' },
      { key: 'b', title: 'Bottom' },
      { key: 'l', title: 'Left' },
    ],
  },
  padding: {
    note: 'Padding utilities on the shared spacing scale (each step = 4px). The light zone is the padding inside the box. Click a card to copy the class name.',
    test: /^\.p([trblxy]?)-(\d+)$/,
    variantOf: (m) => m[1] || 'a',
    scaleOf: (m) => Number(m[2]),
    sections: [
      { key: 'a', title: 'All sides' },
      { key: 'x', title: 'Horizontal — x' },
      { key: 'y', title: 'Vertical — y' },
      { key: 't', title: 'Top' },
      { key: 'r', title: 'Right' },
      { key: 'b', title: 'Bottom' },
      { key: 'l', title: 'Left' },
    ],
  },
}
